mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO class_sessions (user_id, course_id, routine_id, source_date, start_at, end_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{routineId}, #{sourceDate}, #{startAt}, #{endAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM class_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND routine_id = #{routineId} AND source_date = #{sourceDate}

SELECT m.material_id FROM material_links l JOIN course_materials m ON m.material_id = l.material_id AND m.user_id = l.user_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.course_id = #{courseId} AND l.material_type IN ('PROFESSOR_SLIDE', 'OTHER') AND (m.origin IS NULL OR m.origin <> 'CONSULT_PHOTO')
SELECT class_prompt_enabled FROM courses WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE courses SET class_prompt_enabled = #{enabled} WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.section_id, m.material_id, m.original_filename, l.material_type, l.linked_at, (SELECT MIN(w.week_no) FROM material_week_assignments w WHERE w.course_id = l.course_id AND w.material_id = m.material_id AND w.placement = 'WEEK') AS min_week, s.display_title, s.printed_page_start, s.printed_page_end, s.chunk_index FROM material_links l JOIN course_materials m ON m.material_id = l.material_id AND m.user_id = l.user_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN material_sections s ON s.material_id = m.material_id AND s.user_id = m.user_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.file_hash IS NULL OR s.file_hash = m.file_hash) WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.course_id = #{courseId} AND l.material_type IN ('PROFESSOR_SLIDE', 'OTHER') AND (m.origin IS NULL OR m.origin <> 'CONSULT_PHOTO') ORDER BY m.material_id, s.chunk_index, s.unit_start, s.section_id
